deviations.what: The code sets the patent year from grant_year (fy = as.integer(grant_year)) instead of filing_year, so both the base and forward windows are built on grant year.

notes: All other rules match: the first-listed filter, missing-class exclusion, base window fy+1..fy+5, forward window fy-1..fy-3 (both exclude year t), the anti-join for new classes, NA when the base is empty, 0 when the base is non-empty and the forward set is empty, input dedup, and the output columns and rows. The default focal years 1987-2015 are not enforced inside the function (output follows whatever firm_year contains), and empty-string subclasses are treated as missing, which the spec does not address.
